mn102:22.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yaṃ chāyā jahati, taṃ ātapo pharati. yaṃ ātapo jahati, taṃ chāyā pharati.
mn102:22.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, nirāmisassa sukhassa nirodhā uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn102:22.4: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā aparantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā sabbaso kāmasaññojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ upasampajja viharati :
mn102:22.5: ‘etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ upasampajja viharāmī’ti.
mn102:22.7: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya nirodhā uppajjati nirāmisaṃ sukha. nirāmisassa sukhassa nirodhā uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn102:22.8: tayidaṃ saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ, atthi kho pana saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho, atthetanti
mn102:22.9: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgato tadupātivatto.
mn102:23.1: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā aparantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā sabbaso kāmasaññojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya samatikkamā
mn102:24.2: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā, aparantānudiṭṭhīnañca paṭinissaggā sabbaso kāmasaññojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya samatikkamā
mn102:24.5: atha ca panāyaṃ bhavaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubbantānudiṭṭhiṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati. aparantānudiṭṭhiṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati. kāmasaññojanaṃ vā upādiyamāno upādiyati. pavivekaṃ vā pītiṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati. nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati. adukkhamasukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ upādiyamāno upādiyati.
mn102:24.7: ‘santohamasmi, nibbutohamasmi, anupādānohamasmī’ti samanupassati. tadapi imassa bhoto samaṇassa brāhmaṇassa upādānamakkhāyati.
mn102:24.8: tayidaṃ saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ, atthi kho pana saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho, atthetanti
mn102:24.9: iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgato tadupātivatto.
mn102:25.1: idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, tathāgatena anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ abhisambuddhaṃ ‘yadidaṃ
mn102:25.2: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimokkho’ti
mn102:25.4: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
